chapters.title: Definition & Epidemiology
chapters.objective: Define Klinefelter syndrome and place it epidemiologically among sex chromosome aneuploidies
high_yield: Most common sex chromosome aneuploidy in males

chapters.title: Genetics & Pathophysiology
chapters.objective: Trace 47,XXY from meiotic nondisjunction to seminiferous tubule failure

chapters.title: Clinical Presentation
chapters.objective: Recognize the age-stratified phenotype from infancy through adulthood
high_yield: Tall stature with eunuchoid body proportions
Small firm testes (<6 mL, classic <4 mL)
Verbal IQ < performance IQ; expressive language delay

chapters.title: Diagnosis
chapters.objective: Order and interpret the workup; karyotype is the confirmatory test
high_yield: FSH ↑↑, LH ↑, total T ↓ or low-normal
Karyotype on peripheral blood = gold standard

chapters.title: Management
chapters.objective: Apply guideline-directed care across endocrine, fertility, and psychosocial axes
high_yield: Testosterone replacement at pubertal onset (do NOT delay if hypogonadal)
Fertility: TESE + ICSI before age 35 ideal

chapters.title: Complications & Comorbidities
chapters.objective: Anticipate and screen for the long-tail of associated diseases

chapters.title: Final Vignette — Deep USMLE-Style Case
chapters.objective: Integrate ch1–ch6 into a multi-step clinical reasoning challenge
high_yield: Vignette → labs → karyotype → next step in management
chapters.assessment: Single deep MCQ with 5-option AMBOSS-style distractor analysis
